title: From Long Context to Selective Memory:A Survey of Memory-Centric Compression for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.21165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context capability has become essential for large language models (LLMs) to handle complex tasks, yet continuously expanding the context window does not remove the computational, storage, and information-selection pressures incurred at inference time. Existing work on prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory is usually discussed in isolation, leaving the flow of information between storage and computation insufficiently understood. This survey reframes long-context compression as a memory-management problem for allocating inference-time resources. translated_title: 从长上下文到选择性记忆：面向大语言模型的以记忆为中心的压缩综述
translated_abstract: 长上下文能力已成为大语言模型（LLM）处理复杂任务的关键，然而持续扩展上下文窗口并不能消除推理时所产生的计算、存储和信息选择压力。关于提示压缩、KV缓存管理、高效推理服务、检索增强和智能体记忆的现有研究通常是孤立讨论的，导致对存储与计算之间信息流动的理解不足。本综述将长上下文压缩重新构建为一个用于分配推理时资源的记忆管理问题。我们区分了直接参与模型计算的计算活跃记忆与位于计算路径之外、但可以被存储、检索、更新或遗忘的计算非活跃记忆，并将卸载的KV缓存、持久化前缀缓存和预计算的KV状态刻画为二者之间的中间状态。
tldr: 本综述将大语言模型的长上下文压缩重新表述为记忆管理问题，通过区分计算活跃记忆与计算非活跃记忆，统一整合了此前孤立的提示压缩、KV缓存管理、高效推理服务、检索增强与智能体记忆等研究方向。
en_tdlr: This survey reframes long-context compression for LLMs as a memory-management problem, unifying previously isolated research areas—prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory—by distinguishing compute-active from compute-inactive memory.
